# arin_aspa (Resource)

An Autonomous System Provider Authorization under the provider org.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `customer_as` (Number) Customer AS number. This is the ASPA identity, changing
  it replaces the object.
- `provider_as_ids` (Set of Number) Provider AS numbers authorized to propagate
  the customer's routes.
